payload.title: @FrickModel macro for DTO-wrapper scaffolding
payload.description:
## Frick today
Nothing — the model type is "any Codable DTO." No reference-type observable wrapper, no identity/equality base.

## What RangerCRM built
RangerObject marker protocol (/Users/bri/dev/RangerCRM/RangerCRM/Model/RangerData/Services/RangerObject.swift) + 16 *FrickModel classes (/Users/bri/dev/RangerCRM/RangerCRM/Model/RangerData/Models/, ~2,609 LOC). Each wraps a DTO with identical scaffolding — objectId, private(set) dto, apply(_:), Identifiable, Hashable/== on objectId — PLUS domain-specific field accessors and relationship resolvers (which stay app-side).

## What the port gives us
A `@FrickModel` macro that generates the scaffolding from the DTO type, so apps write only fields + relationship resolvers. Defines the FrickModel protocol (associatedtype DTO; objectId; dto; apply) that FrickStore<Model> and @FrickQuery are generic over.

## Notes
Highest effort (a Swift macro target in packages/swift) and the lowest generic fraction of the epic (field accessors/relationships are inherently domain-specific). Sequence LAST — after FrickStore proves the FrickModel contract in plain protocol form. The protocol can ship with the store story; only the macro codegen needs this ticket.

Relates to the store story (defines its Model contract).
